aheadSummary: The union's web event list ends with EC3 (1-3 Nov 2026), but two union PDF calendars reach well past the window: the officers' calendar for 2026-2027 (posted Dec 2025) and the Education department's multi-year planning calendar (updated 24 Jun 2026, to 2030). Union-run in the window: the 21st Southern Union Constituency Session (19-20 Sep 2027) and the SU Leadership conference for educators (16-19 Sep 2027). Three NAD/ASI events meet inside the territory.
usuallyHeldNotYetPublished: Southern Union Evangelism Conference EC3 (1-3 Nov 2026): no 2027 dates published.
No Southern Union or conference page has a OneVoice27 plan for September 2027; world and NAD dates are in initiatives.json.

Inside the year ahead (added in review): SU Academy Prayer Conference 13-16 Jan 2027 and SU Pathfinder Bible Experience 26-27 Mar 2027 (officers' calendar; the education multi-year calendar agrees once its columns are read by weekday). Outside it: SU Chaplain Retreat 19-21 Oct 2027; SU Admin/Departmental Council 14-17 Nov 2027.
excludedFromUnionCalendars: Committee and board meetings (SU Youth & Young Adult Advisory 13-15 Apr 2027, executive committees, LLUH/SAU boards, NAD HR/Secretariat/Treasury councils, GC Spring Meeting 13-14 Apr 2027, NADOUP), staff meetings, holidays and university graduations were left out.
notes: The officers' calendar also shows a second 'CALLED Convention' bar on 26-29 Jul 2027; it is a leftover from the Dec 2024 version (which had CALLED on those dates). NAD's own page and the KYTN calendar give 21-24 Jun 2027, so only the June dates are used. The Dec 2024 union calendar placed the 2027 ASI convention in 'Tampa Bay'; ASI's own page says Orlando, 4-7 Aug 2027. The newest copy of the education calendar (July upload) returns HTTP 403, so the identical June upload (same 24 Jun 2026 edit) is cited.
